title: Validation: Tool Test Timeout Extension
problem: Validation suite times out on slow systems. 5-second timeout insufficient for WMI/Registry cold-start queries.
evidence: systemInfo test hangs >5s on cold start
Timeout blocks validation on 20% of tests
cause: Global timeout threshold (5s) too aggressive for slow I/O operations. WMI cold-start requires 8-10s minimum.
lesson_learned: Timeout is a symptom of performance bottlenecks, not root cause. Increasing timeouts from 5s to 10s exposed underlying WMI cold-start delays that require separate optimization.
